title: knowgov subject check report
description: What tools/check_subject.py --json prints for one subject root (task-0135; doc-0018 F2 to F5), and what tools/check_instance.py --json carries per subject as check. findings are errors (the manifest is refused: exit 1, and a layout error in check_instance.py) and warnings (a required key no document yields, with the near key the documents do yield); each names its rule, where it is, what is wrong and the fix. notes are for reading: a key no document yields with no near match, a register map left unchecked, a yield left unchecked and why, authored documents in a subject that declares no [verification] authored (decision-0009). yield is unchecked when the mappers cannot run where the check runs (they need PyYAML, and the sequence and container mappers pumllint); keys is the number of distinct keys the documents yield. Version 1; a change is additive or a new version.
